name: roam
description: Roam - Pre-owned vehicle buying, selling, and rental marketplace

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = 'node_modules/rollup/dist/native.js'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.writeFileSync(p, 'module.exports = require(\'../../@rollup/wasm-node/dist/native.js\');');"
